title: Day 5 / 500 — ATS-Y1-005 Introduce SurveyProject Object and Reference Semantics
subtitle: Turn disconnected intake values into the first real project-domain object.

steps.title: Day 5.1 Verify Day 4 remote state
steps.why: Start from the normalized intake build so the new object model grows from working code.

steps.title: Day 5.2 Create first SurveyProject domain object
steps.why: Keep project code and estimated-record count together in one domain object.

steps.title: Day 5.3 Add reference-semantics service
steps.why: Create a small service where object-reference behavior can be exercised through real project operations.

steps.title: Day 5.4 Mutate object through copied reference
steps.why: Show that a copied Java reference still reaches the same SurveyProject object and can mutate its state.

steps.title: Day 5.5 Prove parameter reassignment does not replace caller reference
steps.why: Reassign only the local parameter and observe that the caller continues referencing the original SurveyProject.

steps.title: Day 5.6 Guard generic intake with instanceof
steps.why: Check an Object before narrowing it to SurveyProject so an invalid candidate is rejected deliberately.

steps.title: Day 5.7 Integrate SurveyProject into existing application
steps.why: Create the project object from normalized intake and exercise mutation and local-reference replacement in the running application.

steps.why: Run an intentionally invalid Object-to-SurveyProject cast to see the runtime exception that instanceof is protecting against.
